title: Son Thomas and the shift from clarinet to saxophone
summary: Son Thomas played with Rena; bands used guitar and clarinet before saxophone took over.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Say, did you know Son Thomas?
He played with Renny. The first one had one of them old old bands of them. Ten of bands. First one had one around the world.
What were they using before that?

Yes. They were using guitar. They used guitar, I think. But the first one had one of them. They used to use more clarinet around there. Most band around there had clarinet. But after they started using saxophone, most everybody bought saxophone.
